title: Explained the query engine retrieval design in public docs
points: Public docs now introduce psxGPT as a traceable research engine built from a curated corpus, a query engine, deterministic checks, and a repair loop for failures.
The query-engine docs now show how a user question becomes typed asks, page-level concepts, BM25 full-text retrieval, candidate shaping, optional extraction, deterministic compute, and cited answers.

The docs now explain why narrative retrieval is BM25-first today: search_text summaries, MATCH terms, scores, candidate previews, and shaping decisions are inspectable without adding an embedding dependency.
The in-app How psxGPT works page and architecture narrative now describe source summaries, BM25 retrieval, data-quality warnings, traces, evals, and how user-visible errors become fixes.
